description: Follow-up to E035, where removing Lookahead cost -0.81 pp, so averaging is first-order. Test stronger averaging. On tip E031, first read the Lookahead constants in the code (cadence k, peak decay, ramp exponent). Then change only the peak decay of the slow-weight update from 0.95**k to 0.97**k, which roughly doubles the averaging window in steps. Keep the same cubic ramp, cadence and final sync to the slow weights. The GPU alpha table changes; nothing else does.
